text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Examples

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif
ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: to

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif
ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: on

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: this page show our signa-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: tures in their official colours. Specifications

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: for the corporate green, blue and black are on

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: the next two pages.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Each signature has two inseparable elements:

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: symbol and logotype. Neither the symbol

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: nor logotype is ever used in isolation, and no

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: alteration is ever made to their relative

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: positions or proportions.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Logotypes and symbols have a specific cut

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: and spacing; signatures must, therefore,

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: always originate from the official reproduction

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: proofs, and be used exactly as supplied. If a

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: signature must be produced in an extremely

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: large size, the official grid version must be

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: used when rendering by hand in order to

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: maintain the precise configuration.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: The Formal signature is used only as it

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: appears on these two pages; its words are not

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: abbreviated or moved.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Corporate-colour versions of our signatures

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: are used only with the precise colours in their

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: proper locations. There are no colour versions

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: other than those shown here.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Official reproduction proofs, grid versions and

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: colour swatches are available from the

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Advertising Department. Black, white and

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: colour signatures are available on transparent

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: sheets for direct transfer to preliminary

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: designs or presentation materials; sizes range

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: from I" to 5" wide (25 mm to 127 mm).

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif
